title: wedelia montana var. wallichii
intro: Wedelia montana var. wallichii, commonly known as Himalayan Joy Plant or Wild Daisy, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from stress and anxiety due to its adaptogenic and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia montana var. wallichii include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
